title: L2: publish batch packs and catalogs
body:
Parent: #810

Deliver immutable multi-entry remote prefetch packs that remove the cold-run small-object fan-out without weakening Kache's content-addressed trust boundary.

## Required behavior

- Select pack contents from the existing manifest/shard/namespace planning context.
- Use content-addressed, create-only pack objects and bounded metadata.
- Verify every cache-key binding, `meta.json`, artifact name/size, and blob hash before publication.
- Import verified entries in a batch; do not re-hash bytes already verified while streaming extraction.
- Missing, corrupt, incompatible, or incomplete packs fall back to current v3 objects.
- Keep on-demand v3 reads available while a pack is fetched.
- Report pack/v3 request counts, bytes, validation/fallback, and real plan wall time.

## Acceptance

- At least 90% fewer remote requests on the representative cold-node arm.
- No more than 10% extra remote bytes versus object-by-object v3 prefetch.
- Deterministic corruption, traversal, partial-pack, concurrent publication, and fallback tests.
- Five clean representative runs for both object and pack arms.
